text: 3-year-old child. The parents report that the child appears unwell and has been breathing rapidly. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congestive Heart Failure (likely due to Congenital Heart Disease).

The combination of rapid breathing, liver enlargement (hepatomegaly), and pitting edema in a 3-year-old strongly suggests fluid overload from heart failure rather than liver disease or simple infection. Please confirm if the child has any history of cyanosis, difficulty feeding as an infant, or known heart murmur. REQUEST TEST: Echocardiogram. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_XRay.
